info.title: RoyCSS Backend API
info.description: REST API for the RoyCSS platform — generated from the module route table + Zod schemas by `npm run gen:openapi`. Response bodies follow the project envelope: `{ data, meta? }` on success, `{ error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }` on failure.

Meta.description: Pagination/collection metadata: page, limit, total, totalPages | count | query-specific fields.
